ps.en: [[Throughout|throughout]] the year, a young [[writer]] living in an [[urban]] neighborhood felt a quiet [[urge]] to [[write]] about the strangers she passed. She kept a notebook for their faces, though she had no wish to publish it.
ps.zh: 整整一年，一位住在城区的年轻作家，总有一种安静的冲动，想写下擦肩而过的陌生人。她为那些面孔备了一本笔记，却从没想过要发表。

ps.en: A mentor gave her one [[tip]]: a good [[title]] can carry a whole book. She learned to [[utilize]] old records and to [[utter]] only words that were [[urgent]] and true.
ps.zh: 一位前辈给了她一个忠告：一个好标题能撑起整本书。她学会了利用旧档案，也只说出那些紧迫而真实的话。

ps.en: She began to [[wonder]] whether stories could change a city, and she came to [[worship]] the honest witnesses of the past. What seemed small was, in the end, [[worth]] telling — a [[worthwhile]] tale of a [[worthy]] life.
ps.zh: 她开始想知道，故事能否改变一座城；她也渐渐敬仰起过去那些诚实的见证者。看似微小的事，最终值得被讲述——那是一个值得一过的人生。

ps.en: A [[teenager]] with real [[talent]] for machines set his [[target]] on a career in science. He decided to [[take]] a [[technical]] course at the local lab.
ps.zh: 一个对机械确有天赋的少年，把目标锁定在科学事业上。他决定在当地实验室修一门技术课程。

ps.en: An experienced [[technician]] taught him a simple [[technique]], and soon [[technology]] pulled him [[toward]] a future he had never imagined. His father would [[tow]] the old car to the station so he could study late.
ps.zh: 一位经验丰富的技师教他一个简单技巧，科技很快把他拉向一个从未想过的未来。父亲会把旧车拖到车站，好让他深夜还能学习。

ps.en: As the [[temperature]] dropped, his [[temper]] grew calm, and he developed a real [[taste]] for discovery. The boy who once feared failure now built things that worked.
ps.zh: 气温下降时，他的脾气也平和下来，并对探索生出真正的爱好。那个曾经害怕失败的男孩，如今造出了能运转的东西。

ps.en: In a small town, one [[tradition]] survived every [[temporal]] change: neighbours helped one another through [[temporary]] hardship. The old [[term]] for such kindness was simply 'looking after'.
ps.zh: 在一个小镇，有一种传统熬过了每一次时代更迭：邻居们在暂时的困顿中互相帮扶。这种善意的旧称，不过是「照应」二字。

ps.en: New comforts can [[tempt]] the young away from it, and the [[temptation]] to leave is strong. People [[tend]] to forget the past, and this [[tendency]] is hard to [[terminate]]; even the local bus [[terminal]] seemed to [[testify]] to a quieter age.
ps.zh: 新的安逸会引诱年轻人背离它，离去的诱惑格外强烈。人往往遗忘过去，而这股趋势难以终止；连当地的公交终点站，似乎都在为一个更安静的年代作证。

ps.en: Researchers made a [[tentative]] plan to [[trace]] the town's songs and [[track]] its stories before they faded. They would not end the custom by force, only listen and learn.
ps.zh: 研究者拟订了一个试探性的计划，要在那些歌谣与故事消散前追溯、追踪它们。他们不会用强制手段终结习俗，只是倾听与学习。

ps.en: When [[unemployment]] rose, the town grew [[uneasy]]. Few people [[understand]] the forces that [[underlie]] such shocks, and the [[underlying]] cause was easy to [[underestimate]].
ps.zh: 失业攀升时，小镇人心惶惶。很少有人理解那些引发震荡的力量，而其潜在根源，又容易被低估。

ps.en: A planner chose to [[undertake]] a hard task: to [[unify]] divided groups and to [[underline]] what they shared. He listened first, with real [[understanding]], then asked people to change.
ps.zh: 一位规划者选择承担一项艰难任务：把分裂的群体统一起来，并强调他们的共同点。他先倾听，再请人们作出改变。

ps.en: The [[ultimate]] test came from an [[unexpected]] place — a factory that would [[undergo]] a quiet rebirth. What looked like an end was, in truth, a beginning.
ps.zh: 最终的考验来自一个意想不到的地方——一家将悄然重生的工厂。看似终点，实则是一个开端。

stories.zh: 工会与一个独特的诉求

ps.en: A workers' [[union]] fought for a [[unique]] deal, knowing that pay alone was not the only thing of [[value]]. Their cause felt [[universal]], as if the whole [[universe]] were watching.
ps.zh: 一个工会为一份独特的协议而战，因为他们明白，薪酬并非唯一有价值的东西。他们的诉求显得普天同心，仿佛整个宇宙都在注视。

ps.en: The road was hard and [[unlikely]], and some feared their efforts were in [[vain]]. Others called the plan [[unusual]], and the rules seemed [[vague]].
ps.zh: 这条路艰难且未必走得通，有人担心努力终将徒劳。另一些人说这计划不寻常，而规则也显得含糊。

ps.en: Yet their claim was [[valid]], and the data showed real [[variance]] in wages. A [[variable]] world can make good work [[vanish]], but what is truly [[valuable]] endures — [[unlike]] a passing trend.
ps.zh: 然而他们的主张合理，数据也显示出工资间真实的差额。多变的世界能让好的成果转瞬消失，但真正有价值的东西会留存——不像一阵过眼的风潮。

ps.en: There is no single [[way]] to learn. Students [[vary]] in how they think, and a [[variety]] of methods suits a [[vast]] range of needs. Teachers should try [[various]] approaches rather than one fixed rule.
ps.zh: 学习没有唯一的方法。学生的思维方式各不相同，多种多样的方法才能适配广博的需求。教师应当尝试种种不同的途径，而非一条死规矩。

ps.en: A tired clerk used to [[wage]] long arguments about pay, then [[wander]] the streets at night, too [[weak]] to sleep. He began to [[wear]] a calm face even when he felt [[weary]].
ps.zh: 一个疲惫的小职员，曾为薪酬争论不休，夜里在街上徘徊，虚弱得难以入眠。即便感到疲倦，他也开始挂着一副平静的面孔。

ps.en: What did he truly [[want]]? To [[weigh]] his choices honestly and accept the natural [[variation]] in life. The answer was not the fastest route but the one he could keep.
ps.zh: 他真正想要的是什么？是诚实地权衡选择，并接受生命中自然的起伏。答案不是最快的那条路，而是他能一直走下去的那条。

c: throughout the year 整整一年
known throughout the world 举世闻名
words.dif: throughout 强调「整个期间或范围」；through 只指「穿过」，不表全程
words.pat: The policy was debated throughout the autumn.
words.patZh: 这项政策在整个秋天都在被讨论。

c: a useful tip 实用的建议
tip the waiter 给服务员小费
the tip of a pen 笔尖
words.dif: tip 作名词既指「建议」也指「小费」，作动词指「给小费」或「倾斜」
words.pat: Here is a tip: read the question before you answer.
words.patZh: 给你一个忠告：作答前先读题。

c: the title of a book 书名
an official title 官方头衔
fam: entitle v. 给…题名；使有资格
words.dif: title 指「书名/头衔」；topic 指「话题」，不要混
words.pat: The title of her first novel caught everyone's eye.
words.patZh: 她第一部小说的书名抓住了所有人的目光。

words.dif: urban 城市；rural 农村；suburban 郊区，三者成对考
words.pat: Urban pollution remains a pressing challenge for many cities.
words.patZh: 城市污染仍是许多城市面临的紧迫挑战。

words.exam: 推进；力劝；强烈的欲望；冲动
c: urge sb to do 敦促某人做
a sudden urge 一股冲动
words.dif: urge 作动词「力劝」，作名词「冲动」，阅读里两者都考
words.pat: Teachers urge students to think for themselves.
words.patZh: 老师敦促学生独立思考。

c: in urgent need of 急需
words.dif: urgent 强调「时间上紧迫」；critical 强调「至关重要的」
words.pat: Climate change is an urgent issue for all nations.
words.patZh: 气候变化对各国都是紧迫议题。

c: utilize solar energy 利用太阳能
fam: utility n. 效用；公用事业
words.dif: utilize 比 use 更正式，常指「充分利用某物」；use 最通用
words.pat: We should utilize recycled materials in construction.
words.patZh: 我们应在建筑中利用回收材料。

c: utter a word 说出一个字
words.dif: utter 作动词「说出」，作形容词「完全的」，词性常混
words.pat: She did not utter a single word during the meeting.
words.patZh: 会议期间她一言未发。

words.exam: 惊奇；惊讶；感到诧异；想要知道
words.dif: wonder 作动词「想知道/惊讶」，作名词「奇迹」，阅读常考动词义
words.pat: I wonder whether the plan will really work.
words.patZh: 我想知道这个计划是否真的可行。

c: worship a hero 崇拜英雄
freedom of worship 信仰自由
words.dif: worship 偏「宗教性或极度敬仰」；admire 是一般「钦佩」
words.pat: Some fans worship celebrities without knowing them.
words.patZh: 一些粉丝在并不了解的情况下崇拜名人。

c: worth the price 值这个价
of great worth 极有价值
words.dif: worth 后接名词或动名词；worthy 后接 of 或 to do
words.pat: The book is well worth reading twice.
words.patZh: 这本书很值得读两遍。

c: a worthwhile cause 值得的事业
find it worthwhile 觉得值得
a worthwhile trip 不虚此行
words.dif: worthwhile 只作表语或定语形容词；worth 可作表语后接名词/动名词
words.pat: Volunteer work can be a worthwhile use of time.
words.patZh: 志愿工作可以是值得花时间的事。

c: worthy of praise 值得称赞
a worthy cause 正当事业
worthy of note 值得一提
words.dif: worthy 接 of 或 to do；worth 直接接名词/动名词，搭配不同
words.pat: The effort was worthy of public support.
words.patZh: 这一努力值得公众支持。

c: write for a magazine 为杂志撰稿
words.dif: write 是「写」；right 是「正确的/右边」，同音易混
words.pat: Students should write clearly and support their views.
words.patZh: 学生应当写得清晰并支撑自己的观点。

c: a freelance writer 自由撰稿人
a travel writer 旅游作家
become a writer 成为作家
words.dif: writer 泛指写作者；author 常指「书的作者」，更正式
words.pat: A good writer observes life before describing it.
words.patZh: 优秀的作家在描写生活前先观察生活。

c: a tow truck 救援拖车
words.dif: tow 专指「用绳/车拖拽」；pull 是最泛指的「拉」
words.pat: The broken car was towed to the garage.
words.patZh: 抛锚的车被拖到了修车厂。

c: an attitude toward 对…的态度
fam: towards prep. 同义（英式更常用）
words.dif: toward 后接方向或对象；to 更通用，toward 强调「朝向、接近」
words.pat: Her research moved toward a clearer conclusion.
words.patZh: 她的研究朝着更清晰的结论推进。

words.exam: 拿取；带去；吃；接受；需要；花费；看法；意见
words.dif: take 义项极多（花费/接受/认为），阅读里常考「花费时间」与「持某种看法」
words.pat: It takes courage to admit one's mistake.
words.patZh: 承认自己的错误需要勇气。

c: a talent for music 音乐天赋
words.dif: talent 偏「先天禀赋」；skill 偏「后天习得的技能」
words.pat: She has a talent for explaining difficult ideas simply.
words.patZh: 她有一种把难懂的想法讲简单的天赋。

c: meet a target 达成目标
words.dif: target 既是「靶子/目标」也是动词「针对」；goal 只作名词
words.pat: The new policy targets young job seekers.
words.patZh: 新政策针对年轻求职者。

c: a taste for art 对艺术的爱好
words.dif: taste 常考「鉴赏力/爱好」，而非「味道」这一字面义
words.pat: She has excellent taste in modern architecture.
words.patZh: 她对现代建筑有极佳的鉴赏力。

c: a technical college 技术学院
words.dif: technical 指「技术性的/专业的」；technological 指「科技（应用）的」
words.pat: The report is too technical for ordinary readers.
words.patZh: 这份报告对普通读者来说太专业了。

c: a lab technician 实验室技术员
a skilled technician 熟练技工
words.dif: technician 是「技术人员/技工」；engineer 是「工程师」，层级更高
words.pat: A technician fixed the machine within an hour.
words.patZh: 一名技师在一小时内修好了机器。

c: master a technique 掌握技巧
words.dif: technique 是「做事的技巧/方法」；technology 是「科技/技术（总称）」
words.pat: Good writing requires both ideas and technique.
words.patZh: 好的写作既需要思想也需要技巧。

words.dif: technology 是「科学技术总称」；technique 是「具体技巧」
words.pat: Technology has changed how we learn and work.
words.patZh: 科技改变了我们学习和工作的方式。

c: a troubled teenager 烦恼的少年
words.dif: teenager 指「13–19 岁青少年」；adolescent 更偏医学/心理用语
words.pat: Many teenagers learn coding before they leave school.
words.patZh: 许多青少年在毕业前就学了编程。

c: a hot temper 暴躁脾气
temper criticism with 以…缓和批评
words.dif: temper 作名词「脾气」，作动词「使缓和」，僻义常考动词
words.pat: He tempered his words so as not to offend.
words.patZh: 他措辞缓和以免冒犯。

words.dif: temperature 是「温度」；temper 是「脾气/缓和」，拼写相近易混
words.pat: The temperature dropped sharply after nightfall.
words.patZh: 日落后气温骤降。

words.dif: temporal 指「世俗的/时间的」；temporary 指「暂时的」，二者易混
words.pat: The church and temporal authorities often disagreed.
words.patZh: 教会与世俗当局常常意见相左。

c: a temporary job 临时工作
words.dif: temporary 是「暂时的」；permanent 是其反义「永久的」
words.pat: The bridge was closed for temporary repairs.
words.patZh: 大桥因临时维修而关闭。

c: tempt sb to do 诱使…做
words.dif: tempt 强调「引诱去犯错/冒险」；attract 是中性「吸引」
words.pat: High salaries tempted him to leave academia.
words.patZh: 高薪诱使他离开学界。

c: the temptation to 做…的诱惑
yield to temptation 屈服于诱惑
words.dif: temptation 是名词「诱惑」；tempt 是动词，二者同根
words.pat: The temptation to take shortcuts is strong under pressure.
words.patZh: 在压力下走捷径的诱惑很强。

c: tend to do 往往会做
tend a garden 照料花园
words.dif: tend 常考「往往会/照料」两义；tendency 是其名词「趋势」
words.pat: People tend to remember the first and last items.
words.patZh: 人们往往记得开头和结尾的内容。

c: a tendency to 有…的倾向
a downward tendency 下降趋势
show a tendency 显现趋势
words.dif: tendency 是「趋势/倾向」；trend 多指「大的潮流/趋向」
words.pat: There is a tendency to equate wealth with success.
words.patZh: 有一种把财富等同于成功的倾向。

c: a tentative plan 暂定计划
a tentative step 试探性的一步
words.dif: tentative 指「未定的/试探的」；certain 是其反义
words.pat: We reached a tentative deal pending final approval.
words.patZh: 我们达成了一份尚待最终批准的初步协议。

words.exam: 学期；期限；条款；术语；说法；措词；关系
c: in the long term 长远来看
words.dif: term 义项多（学期/术语/条款/关系）；terms 常指「条件/关系」
words.pat: In the long term, education pays off.
words.patZh: 长远来看，教育终有回报。

c: a bus terminal 公交终点站
a terminal patient 晚期病人
words.dif: terminal 作名词「终点站/终端」，作形容词「晚期的/末端的」
words.pat: The train pulled into the terminal just before midnight.
words.patZh: 火车在午夜前驶入终点站。

c: terminate a contract 终止合同
terminate the call 挂断电话
words.dif: terminate 比 end 正式，常指「依法/按计划终止」
words.pat: The lease will terminate at the end of the year.
words.patZh: 租约将于年底终止。

c: testify in court 出庭作证
words.dif: testify 常接 to 或 that 从句；proof 是名词「证据」
words.pat: The data testify to a clear improvement.
words.patZh: 数据证实了明显的改善。

c: trace one's roots 追溯根源
without a trace 毫无踪迹
trace a call 追踪来电
words.dif: trace 与 track 都含「追踪」，trace 偏「溯源/微量」，track 偏「跟踪轨迹」
words.pat: Scientists traced the outbreak to a single market.
words.patZh: 科学家将疫情暴发溯源到同一个市场。

c: keep track of 掌握…的动态
on the right track 思路正确
track a package 跟踪包裹
words.dif: track 强调「沿轨迹跟踪」；trace 强调「查出源头」
words.pat: It is hard to keep track of every new rule.
words.patZh: 很难掌握每一条新规则的动向。

c: break with tradition 打破传统
words.dif: tradition 是「代代相传的传统」；habit 是「个人习惯」
words.pat: Family traditions help children feel rooted.
words.patZh: 家庭传统让孩子感到有根基。

c: the ultimate goal 终极目标
the ultimate cause 根本原因
words.dif: ultimate 既指「最后的」也指「根本的」；final 只指「最终的」
words.pat: The ultimate aim of study is wisdom, not grades.
words.patZh: 学习的根本目的是智慧，而非分数。

c: underestimate the risk 低估风险
words.dif: underestimate 是「低估」；overestimate 是其反义「高估」
words.pat: We should not underestimate the cost of delay.
words.patZh: 我们不应低估拖延的代价。

fam: underwent（过去式） n. 相关延伸
undergone（过去分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: undergo 是及物「经历/承受（过程）」；experience 更通用
words.pat: The city underwent rapid transformation.
words.patZh: 这座城市经历了快速的转型。

c: underlie a theory 是理论的基础
underlie the conflict 是冲突的根源
words.dif: underlie 是「位于…之下/构成基础」，及物且较正式
words.pat: A simple idea underlies the whole system.
words.patZh: 一个简单的理念构成了整个体系的基础。

c: the underlying cause 根本原因
an underlying problem 潜在问题
words.dif: underlying 是「潜在的/根本的」；obvious 是其反义
words.pat: We must address the underlying cause, not the symptom.
words.patZh: 我们必须解决根本原因，而非表象。

c: underline a word 在词下划线
underline the risk 强调风险
underline the point 强调要点
fam: underline = under + line n. 相关延伸
words.dif: underline 字面「下划线」，引申「强调」；emphasize 只作「强调」
words.pat: The report underlines the need for reform.
words.patZh: 报告强调了改革的必要性。

c: make oneself understood 使别人理解自己
words.dif: understand 最通用「理解」；comprehend 偏「透彻领会」，更正式
words.pat: Good teachers help students understand, not just memorize.
words.patZh: 好的老师帮助学生理解，而不只是记忆。

c: reach an understanding 达成谅解
a deep understanding 深刻理解
words.dif: understanding 作名词「理解/谅解」，作形容词「通情达理的」
words.pat: Mutual understanding is the key to teamwork.
words.patZh: 相互理解是团队合作的关键。

c: undertake a task 承担任务
fam: undertook（过去式） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: undertake 是「承担/答应做」，较正式；take on 也可表承担
words.pat: The lab will undertake a new climate study.
words.patZh: 该实验室将着手一项新的气候研究。

words.exam: 心神不宁的；令人不安的；不自在的
c: an uneasy peace 不稳定的和平
words.dif: uneasy 指「不安/不自在」；nervous 强调「紧张」，语义近
words.pat: Investors grew uneasy after the sudden news.
words.patZh: 突发的消息让投资者感到不安。

words.dif: unemployment 是「失业（现象/人数）」；unemployed 指「失业的（人）」
words.pat: Unemployment rose during the economic slowdown.
words.patZh: 经济放缓期间失业人数上升。

c: an unexpected guest 不速之客
wholly unexpected 完全出乎意料
words.dif: unexpected 是「未预料到的」；unpredictable 是「不可预测的」
words.pat: An unexpected opportunity changed her career.
words.patZh: 一个意外的机会改变了她的职业。

c: unify the country 统一国家
words.dif: unify 强调「整合为整体」；unite 强调「联合/团结」
words.pat: The reform aimed to unify the scattered rules.
words.patZh: 改革旨在统一散乱的规章。

words.dif: union 指「联合/工会/同盟」；unity 指「团结/一体性」
words.pat: The workers formed a union to protect their rights.
words.patZh: 工人们组建了工会以维护自身权利。

c: a unique style 独特风格
truly unique 真正独一无二
words.dif: unique 是「独一无二」；rare 是「稀有」，程度不同
words.pat: Every student has a unique way of learning.
words.patZh: 每个学生都有独一无二的学习方式。

c: a universal rule 普遍规律
words.dif: universal 是「普遍/全体的」；particular 是其反义「特定的」
words.pat: Access to education should be a universal right.
words.patZh: 受教育应是一项普遍权利。

c: the visible universe 可观测宇宙
the laws of the universe 宇宙法则
the whole universe 整个宇宙
words.dif: universe 是「宇宙」；university 是「大学」，拼写相近易混
words.pat: The universe is far larger than we can imagine.
words.patZh: 宇宙远比我们所能想象的更为浩瀚。

c: unlike any other 与众不同
words.dif: unlike 作介词「不像」；dislike 是动词「不喜欢」，勿混
words.pat: Unlike his brother, he preferred quiet study.
words.patZh: 与他哥哥不同，他更喜欢安静地学习。

words.exam: 未必的；靠不住的；不像的
c: an unlikely hero 不可能的英雄
words.dif: unlikely 是「不太可能的」；impossible 是「不可能的」，程度更强
words.pat: It is unlikely that the weather will improve today.
words.patZh: 今天天气转好的可能性不大。

c: an unusual sight 罕见的景象
words.dif: unusual 是「不寻常的」；unique 是「独一无二的」，程度不同
words.pat: The child showed an unusual gift for music.
words.patZh: 这个孩子展现出过人的音乐天赋。

c: a vague answer 含糊的回答
words.dif: vague 强调「模糊不清」；ambiguous 强调「有歧义」，二者常同框
words.pat: His explanation was too vague to be useful.
words.patZh: 他的解释太含糊，没什么用处。

words.exam: 徒劳的；自负的；爱虚荣的
c: a vain attempt 徒劳的尝试
words.dif: vain 既指「徒劳」也指「自负的」；futile 只指「徒劳」
words.pat: All our efforts were in vain.
words.patZh: 我们所有的努力都付诸东流。

words.exam: 合理的；有效的；有根据的；具有法律效力的
c: a valid reason 合理的理由
a valid passport 有效护照
words.dif: valid 指「有效/有根据的」；legal 指「合法的」，侧重点不同
words.pat: Her argument is valid and well supported.
words.patZh: 她的论点合理且有充分支撑。

c: lock up valuables 锁好贵重物品
words.dif: valuable 是「有价值的」；priceless 是「无价的」，程度更强
words.pat: Time is the most valuable resource we have.
words.patZh: 时间是我们拥有的最宝贵资源。

words.exam: 价值；重要性；价值观；估价；评价；重视
fam: values 价值观（复） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: value 作名词「价值」、动词「重视」；values 复数常指「价值观」
words.pat: Societies differ in the values they hold.
words.patZh: 不同社会所持的价值观各不相同。

c: vanish from sight 消失在视线中
vanish into thin air 凭空消失
vanish without trace 消失得无影无踪
words.dif: vanish 强调「突然/神秘地消失」；disappear 是通用「消失」
words.pat: Old customs can vanish in a single generation.
words.patZh: 旧习俗可能在一代人之间就消失了。

words.exam: 易变的；可变的；可变因素
c: a key variable 关键变量
words.dif: variable 是「易变的/变量」；varied 是「多样化的」，勿混
words.pat: The results depend on several variable factors.
words.patZh: 结果取决于若干可变因素。

c: at variance with 与…不一致
a wide variance 巨大差异
words.dif: variance 指「差异/差额/变化幅度」；variation 指「变化/变种」
words.pat: The report showed a wide variance in regional wages.
words.patZh: 报告显示了地区工资间的巨大差额。

c: from various sources 来自各处
words.dif: various 是「各种各样的」；variable 是「易变的」，拼写相近
words.pat: The problem can be solved in various ways.
words.patZh: 这个问题可以用种种方法解决。

c: a slight variation 细微变化
words.dif: variation 强调「变化/变体」；variety 强调「多种多样」
words.pat: There is considerable variation in test scores.
words.patZh: 考试分数存在相当大的变化。

words.dif: variety 指「种类多/多样性」；variation 指「同一事物的变化」
words.pat: A variety of factors shaped the result.
words.patZh: 多种多样的因素塑造了这一结果。

words.dif: vary 是动词「变化/不同」；vary from 表「不同于」，vary in 表「在某方面不同」
words.pat: Prices vary greatly between seasons.
words.patZh: 价格随季节差异很大。

c: a vast area 辽阔的区域
a vast difference 天壤之别
words.dif: vast 强调「辽阔/巨量」；huge 强调「体量大」，近义
words.pat: The project demands a vast amount of data.
words.patZh: 该项目需要海量的数据。

c: a living wage 糊口工资
wage a war 发动战争
wage a campaign 开展运动
fam: wages n. 工资（多指周薪）
words.dif: wage 作名词「工资（常周薪）」，作动词「进行/发动（战争、运动）」
words.pat: They waged a long campaign for clean air.
words.patZh: 他们为清洁空气开展了一场持久的运动。

c: wander in the park 在公园漫步
let one's mind wander 走神
words.dif: wander 是「漫步/走神」；wonder 是「想知道/惊奇」，拼写极近
words.pat: His mind began to wander during the long lecture.
words.patZh: 在漫长的讲座中他开始走神。

c: want for nothing 什么都不缺
meet one's wants 满足需求
words.dif: want 既指「想要」也指「缺少」，阅读常考「缺乏」义
words.pat: The plan failed for want of support.
words.patZh: 该计划因缺乏支持而失败。

words.exam: 方法；方式；方面；道路；路线；作风
c: in a way 在某种程度上
find a way 找到办法
words.dif: way 义项极多（方法/道路/方面）；method 只指「方法」
words.pat: There is no easy way to master a language.
words.patZh: 掌握一门语言没有捷径。

c: a weak excuse 站不住脚的借口
words.dif: weak 指「虚弱/薄弱」；week 是「星期」，同音形近
words.pat: His argument is weak and unconvincing.
words.patZh: 他的论点薄弱且缺乏说服力。

c: wear a smile 面带微笑
fam: wore（过去式） n. 相关延伸
worn（过去分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: wear 是「穿/戴/磨损」；weary 是「疲倦的」，拼写相近
words.pat: She would wear a calm smile despite the stress.
words.patZh: 尽管压力大，她依然面带平静的微笑。

c: a weary journey 令人疲惫的旅程
words.dif: weary 是「疲倦/厌烦」；wary 是「警惕的」，拼写极近
words.pat: Travellers grew weary after the long delay.
words.patZh: 旅客在长时间延误后感到疲惫。

words.exam: 称…的重量；称；对看法或决定有影响；权衡
c: weigh the pros and cons 权衡利弊
words.dif: weigh 常考「权衡/有影响」，不止「称重」；weight 是名词「重量」
words.pat: We must weigh the costs against the benefits.
words.patZh: 我们必须权衡成本与收益。
